rationale: All three protected limitations held their original strength. Self-report still “may have inflated” the association through shared response tendencies. The six-week window still “does not establish temporal ordering,” and “leaving open the possibility that exhaustion disrupts routines” preserves reverse causation. Narrow recruitment still “may limit generalization” to the same populations. No limitation was deleted or converted into a strength, and the tighter combined paragraph is authorized by R-1 and R-2.
